title: Marketing / Duo / Background choices
slide_intent: Evaluate color relationships around a mascot because a recognizable hue can become visually harsh in the wrong surroundings.
strategic_value: Selective backgrounds can keep Duo’s green distinctive and comfortable to view in marketing.
demonstration: Two Duo examples appear on white and bright green fields beside a warning about harsh color vibration.
practical_value: Test the mascot against the approved background set instead of assuming every palette color is interchangeable.

content_islands.name: Selection rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the Duo label, On Backgrounds heading and explanation at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that Duo’s vibrant green can vibrate and look harsh against other colors.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples show Duo on white and bright green backgrounds.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source limits Duo to selected secondary background colors.

ingredient.name: Duo background colors
ingredient.role: Support the mascot’s green without harsh color interaction.
ingredient.application: Use the selected backgrounds supplied for Duo and check their relationship to his green.
ingredient.scope: Historical marketing guidance; the two visible examples do not establish a complete exclusive two-color palette.
